name: Untold Horrors (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Path of the Bloodied Chain

Benefit: Creatures that fail their Will saves against the nightblade’s umbral shackles hear naught but the rattle of the chains, effectively deafening them as long as they remain shaken, frightened, or panicked by the umbral shackles.
